title: NVIDIA says physical-AI revenue nearly tripled in its third quarter and is on track to exceed $25B for the fiscal year
summary: On its Nov 17 earnings call NVIDIA's interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress said physical-AI revenue nearly tripled from a year earlier in the quarter and is on track to exceed $25B for the full year. The Robot Report notes that is about 6% of NVIDIA's projected annual revenue of more than $400B and that 'physical AI' covers more than robotics.
key_figures: physical-AI revenue nearly 3x year over year in Q3 FY27; on track to exceed $25B for the fiscal year; edge-computing revenue up 42% year over year to $8.2B; about 6% of projected revenue above $400B (Robot Report calculation)

summary: Chairman Brian Mast used Export Control Reform Act authority to publish licence-application records showing Chinese buyers asked to import 3.4 million Nvidia and AMD AI chips and Commerce approved more than 879,000 of them. Press reports of the documents put 21 licences, Dec 2025 to May 2026, with 75,000 chips for Alibaba, 150,000 for Tencent, 43,000 for Baidu and 4,000 for BYD; Nvidia says it has since stopped shipping H200s to China.

title: FCC adopts rules opening the 450 MHz band to drone data links and allowing ground radar to track drones at 24.45-24.65 GHz
summary: At its Nov 19 open meeting the FCC adopted a Report and Order under 'Unleashing American Drone Dominance' that opens the 450 MHz band to flight-safety data links for drones and advanced air mobility and moves it to a nationwide licence. It also lets ground-based radars use 24.45-24.65 GHz to detect and track drones near airports, borders, prisons and stadiums, and updates the 800 MHz air-ground broadband rules.
key_figures: Aura Network Systems holds all 54 ground-station licences and says it has invested more than $100M since 2021; build-out options: 5,000 ft coverage over 50% of the area by year 4 and 90% by year 8, or 400 ft coverage over 35% by year 4 and 70% by year 8 (from the October draft order; final text not yet released); GN Docket 26-74 and WT Docket 24-629
already_tracked_check: tracked_check '450 MHz|drone dominance' no hits; FCC robot Covered List, conditional-approval and test-lab items exist; the only drone policy record is the Section 232 drone proclamation (08-13)
note: The Federal Register Sunshine notice (item 2 on the agenda) proves the meeting and docket numbers; the adoption and details come from the FCC release as reprinted by Pipeline and from Aviation International News. fcc.gov returned HTTP 403 to curl.
